title: The Student Software License Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Verified educational licensing programs and eligibility requirements. The Student Software License Database records educational licensing programs: which software offers student licenses, the price or discount, eligibility verification methods, license duration, and the official signup link. Each program is verified against the vendor's education page. The Signature side adds renewal trackers so licenses never lapse mid-term.
capabilities: Record student licensing programs with prices and terms
Document eligibility verification methods
Track license durations and renewal dates
Verify programs against vendor education pages
Provide renewal trackers per program

title: The Student Software License Database — Connection layer: public to Signature record mapping
